SHOULD TAKE.exampleZh: 【解析】間接引語中，護士提醒病人的內容是一種建議或義務，過去式的引述動詞 (reminded) 後面常搭配 should + 原形動詞，表示「應該要吃藥」，故選 (C)。

FATIGUE.example: She was suffering from extreme fatigue after the long flight.
FATIGUE.exampleZh: 在長途飛行後，她感到極度疲勞。

examples.en: She was suffering from extreme fatigue after the long flight.
examples.zh: 在長途飛行後，她感到極度疲勞。

examples.en: Mental fatigue can severely affect your decision-making abilities.
examples.zh: 精神疲勞會嚴重影響你的決策能力。

WOULD HAVE AVOIDED.example: A: 「He fainted during the marathon.」 B: 「If he had stayed hydrated, he would have avoided such a severe condition.」
WOULD HAVE AVOIDED.exampleZh: 【解析】對話討論過去發生的事，使用第三類條件句

HAD SPREAD.example: The researchers discovered that the virus had spread to several other regions before the quarantine began.
HAD SPREAD.exampleZh: 【解析】病毒擴散發生在開始隔離 (began) 之前，屬於「過去的過去」，因此要用過去完成式 (had spread)，選 (B)

SEVERE HEADACHES.example: 【短文】Patient Record Notes: The patient came in complaining of vision blurriness. During the consultation, she mentioned that she had suffered from severe headaches for months before she finally changed her prescription glasses. Q: What issue did the patient have before changing her glasses?
SEVERE HEADACHES.exampleZh: 【解析】短文中提到病患表示在換處方眼鏡前，已經受嚴重頭痛之苦好幾個月 (had suffered from severe headaches for months)，故選 (C)

THERAPY.example: Doctors often prescribe physical therapy to help patients recover their mobility after an accident.

HAD SUFFERED.example: The curator noted that the sculpture had suffered minor damage before it was shipped to the gallery.
HAD SUFFERED.exampleZh: 【解析】雕像受損的動作發生在被運送 (was shipped) 到畫廊之前，代表過去的過去，需使用過去完成式 (had suffered)，選 (B)

HAD PUSHED.example: The critic wrote that the contemporary exhibition had pushed the boundaries of traditional aesthetics.
HAD PUSHED.exampleZh: 【解析】引述動詞 wrote 為過去式，從句時態必須配合退後

INSPIRATION.example: The artist drew her inspiration from the beautiful landscapes she saw during her trip to Italy.

WOULD HAVE QUEUED.example: A: 「The concert tickets sold out in minutes.」 B: 「If we had known earlier, we would have queued online faster.」
WOULD HAVE QUEUED.exampleZh: 【解析】第三類條件句，與過去事實相反

HAD WRITTEN.example: The author explained that he had written the novel over a span of ten years.
HAD WRITTEN.exampleZh: 【解析】間接引語中引述動詞 explained 是過去式，從句表示在他解釋之前已經寫了十年，需退後一個時態使用過去完成式 (had written)，選 (C)

ABSTRACT.example: The gallery features a collection of abstract art, focusing on shapes and colors rather than realistic figures.

HAD VIOLATED.example: The lawyer proved that the corporation had violated the safety regulations before the accident occurred.
HAD VIOLATED.exampleZh: 【解析】違反規定的動作發生在意外發生 (occurred) 之前，表示過去的過去，需使用過去完成式 (had violated)，選 (B)

HAD BREACHED.example: The judge stated that the defendant had breached the terms of the contract intentionally.
HAD BREACHED.exampleZh: 【解析】間接引語中，引述動詞 stated 為過去式，從句原本的過去式 (breached) 須退後為過去完成式 (had breached)，故選 (C)

LAWSUIT.example: Consumers have the right to file a lawsuit if they purchase products that are inherently dangerous.

WOULD HAVE WON.example: A: 「The customer lost the case.」 B: 「If she had kept the original receipt, she would have won the dispute easily.」
WOULD HAVE WON.exampleZh: 【解析】If 從句使用 had kept，表示與過去事實相反（她沒有保留收據）

HAD SOLD.example: The authorities discovered that the store had sold illegal goods for months before being reported.
HAD SOLD.exampleZh: 【解析】販賣非法商品發生在被檢舉 (before being reported) 和當局發現 (discovered) 之前，屬於過去的過去，需使用過去完成式，故選 (B)

BARGAIN.example: You should bargain with the seller.
BARGAIN.exampleZh: 你應該和賣家討價還價。

examples.en: You should bargain with the seller.
examples.zh: 你應該和賣家討價還價。

examples.en: They often bargain at the night market.
examples.zh: 他們經常在夜市討價還價。

examples.en: This shirt is a real bargain!
examples.zh: 這件襯衫真是個便宜貨！

examples.en: I will buy it because it is a bargain.
examples.zh: 我會買它，因為它很划算。

PROMOTION.example: He got a promotion last month.

BACKGROUND.example: My educational background has prepared me for this role.
BACKGROUND.exampleZh: 我的教育背景讓我為這個角色做好了準備。

examples.en: My educational background has prepared me for this role.
examples.zh: 我的教育背景讓我為這個角色做好了準備。

examples.en: Candidates with a strong background will be considered.
examples.zh: 具有強大背景的候選人將會被考慮。

CANDIDATE.example: She is the best candidate for the job.
CANDIDATE.exampleZh: 她是這份工作最好的人選。

APPLICANT.example: There are many applicants for this job.
APPLICANT.exampleZh: 這份工作有很多申請人。

examples.en: The successful applicant will start next week.
examples.zh: 錄取的申請人下週將開始工作。

examples.en: We interviewed three applicants yesterday.
examples.zh: 我們昨天面試了三位申請人。

MOTIVATION.example: He lacks the motivation to study harder.
MOTIVATION.exampleZh: 他缺乏更努力學習的動機。

examples.en: He lacks the motivation to study harder.
examples.zh: 他缺乏更努力學習的動機。

examples.en: Money is not my only motivation.
examples.zh: 金錢不是我唯一的動機。

OBJECTIVE.example: Our main objective is to satisfy our customers.
OBJECTIVE.exampleZh: 我們的主要目標是讓客戶滿意。

examples.en: Our main objective is to satisfy our customers.
examples.zh: 我們的主要目標是讓客戶滿意。

examples.en: The objective which we set was finally met.
examples.zh: 我們設定的目標終於達成了。

OUTSTANDING.example: If her work is outstanding, she will get a promotion.
OUTSTANDING.exampleZh: 如果她的表現傑出，她將會獲得升職。

examples.en: If her work is outstanding, she will get a promotion.
examples.zh: 如果她的表現傑出，她將會獲得升職。

examples.en: The outstanding service has been praised.
examples.zh: 這項傑出的服務已經受到了讚賞。

SHORTAGE.example: The shortage of materials is causing some delays.
SHORTAGE.exampleZh: 材料的短缺正在造成一些延誤。

examples.en: The shortage of materials is causing some delays.
examples.zh: 材料的短缺正在造成一些延誤。

examples.en: We were experiencing a shortage when the supplier closed.
examples.zh: 當供應商倒閉時，我們正在經歷物資短缺。

HAD PROCESSED.example: By the time the manager arrived, the AI software had processed all the raw data.

SIMULATE.example: The new program can simulate human conversations very well, making customer service faster.
SIMULATE.exampleZh: 空格處需要填入符合句意的動詞。

WOULD REQUIRE.example: The engineer explained that the system would require a major update the following week.
WOULD REQUIRE.exampleZh: 本題測驗間接引語的時態一致性。

AUTOMATION.example: Because of automation, many repetitive tasks in the factory are now done by robots instead of humans.
AUTOMATION.exampleZh: 句意為「因為自動化，工廠裡許多重複性的工作現在都由機器人取代人類來完成」。

ALLOCATE.example: Allocate additional resources to the project.

WOULDNT HAVE RUN.example: If the clinic had ordered more supplies, they wouldn't have run out of masks during the outbreak.
WOULDNT HAVE RUN.exampleZh: 本題測驗第三類條件句（與過去事實相反）

HAD TO STOP.example: The doctor warned the patient that he had to stop taking the medicine immediately.

HAD GIVEN.example: By the time the ambulance reached the scene, the volunteers had given first aid to the victims.
HAD GIVEN.exampleZh: 由 By the time 加上過去式動詞 reached 可知，志工給予急救的動作發生在救護車抵達之前，屬於「過去的過去」，因此必須使用過去完成式 (had given)

VULNERABLE.example: The new policy aims to protect the most vulnerable groups, such as the elderly and those with chronic illnesses.
VULNERABLE.exampleZh: 句意為「這項新政策旨在保護最脆弱的族群，例如長者和慢性病患」。

TRANSFORM.example: The small fishing village has managed to transform itself into a popular resort destination.
TRANSFORM.exampleZh: 句意為「這座小漁村成功地將自己轉變為受歡迎的度假勝地」。

PRESERVE.example: To preserve the historical buildings, the city council decided to limit the number of daily visitors.
PRESERVE.exampleZh: 句意為「為了保存歷史建築，市議會決定限制每日遊客數量」。

COULD HAVE CHOSEN.meaning: 當時本來可以選擇其他日期
COULD HAVE CHOSEN.example: A: 「The flight was delayed for six hours!」 B: 「If we had checked the weather forecast, we could have chosen a different travel date.」
COULD HAVE CHOSEN.exampleZh: 本題為第三類條件句（與過去事實相反）。

AUTHENTIC.example: Finding authentic local food is my main goal when traveling.
AUTHENTIC.exampleZh: 尋找道地的當地美食是我旅行時的主要目標。

examples.en: Finding authentic local food is my main goal when traveling.
examples.zh: 尋找道地的當地美食是我旅行時的主要目標。

examples.en: The restaurant that serves authentic Italian pasta is nearby.
examples.zh: 那家提供道地義大利麵的餐廳就在附近。

WOULD GO.example: The inspector announced that the new labeling regulations would go into effect next month.
WOULD GO.exampleZh: 引述動詞 announced 為過去式，從屬子句中描述未來的動作 (next month) 應將 will go 退一步為 would go，符合間接引語的時態規則。

INGREDIENTS.example: Consumers should carefully read the list of ingredients to avoid allergic reactions.
INGREDIENTS.exampleZh: 句意為「消費者應仔細閱讀成分表以避免過敏反應」。

HAD USED.example: The authorities found that the factory had used expired meat for several months before the inspection.
HAD USED.exampleZh: 政府發現 (found) 是一個過去式的動作，而工廠使用過期肉類是發生在檢查「之前」好幾個月的事，屬於過去的過去，必須使用過去完成式 (had used)

STRICTLY.example: The use of artificial food coloring is strictly prohibited in organic products.
STRICTLY.exampleZh: 句意為「有機產品中嚴格禁止使用人工食用色素」。

REGULATE.example: The government plans to establish a new agency to regulate the production and distribution of dietary supplements.
REGULATE.exampleZh: 句意為「政府計劃成立一個新機構來規範膳食補充劑的生產與銷售」。

HAD INCREASED.example: By the time the new subway line opened, the construction budget had increased by twenty percent.
HAD INCREASED.exampleZh: By the time 加上過去式 opened 點出過去的時間基準

WOULD BUILD.example: The mayor promised that the city council would build more bike lanes by the end of the year.
WOULD BUILD.exampleZh: 主要子句動詞 promised 為過去式，名詞子句中描述「年底前將會建造」的未來動作，需要依據時態一致性退一步，將 will 轉成 would，故選 C。

WOULD DRIVE.example: If public transportation were completely free, fewer people would drive their cars to work.
WOULD DRIVE.exampleZh: 條件子句 If public transportation were... 顯示為第二類條件句，表示與現在事實相反的假設，主要子句要搭配 would + 原形動詞，所以選 would drive。

ACCELERATE.example: To accelerate the transition to green energy, the government is offering subsidies for purchasing electric vehicles.
ACCELERATE.exampleZh: 句意為「為了加速向綠能轉型，政府針對購買電動車提供補助」。

WOULDNT HAVE BEEN.example: A: 「The traffic jam was terrible this morning.」 B: 「If you had taken the train, you wouldn't have been late for the meeting.」
WOULDNT HAVE BEEN.exampleZh: 對話討論的是今天早上已經發生的塞車，為與過去事實相反的假設語氣（第三類條件句）

PEDESTRIANS.example: The new bridge was designed specifically for pedestrians and cyclists, so cars are not allowed to enter.
PEDESTRIANS.exampleZh: 句意為「這座新橋是專為行人和自行車騎士設計的，所以禁止汽車進入」。

ASSESS.example: We need to assess the damage.

ESTIMATE.example: Can you give me an estimate?
ESTIMATE.exampleZh: 你可以給我一個估價嗎？

REVENUE.meaning: 政府透過稅收或企業營運獲得之總收入
REVENUE.example: Tax revenue declined precipitously during the industrial downturn.
REVENUE.exampleZh: 在工業景氣低迷期間政府稅收出現了斷崖式下滑。

senses.meaning: 政府透過稅收或企業營運獲得之總收入

examples.en: Tax revenue declined precipitously during the industrial downturn.
examples.zh: 在工業景氣低迷期間政府稅收出現了斷崖式下滑。

SPONSOR.exampleZh: 這場活動有三家贊助商。

SURPLUS.example: The country has a trade surplus.

QUOTATION.example: Could you send us a quotation?
QUOTATION.exampleZh: 可以寄報價單給我們嗎？

HAD MANAGED.example: If the factory had managed its chemical waste properly, the local river would not have been polluted.
HAD MANAGED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：主要子句為 would not have been (與過去事實相反)，條件句應使用過去完成式 If + had + p.p.

HAD DONATED.example: The CEO stated that they had donated ten percent of their annual earnings to local charities the previous year.
HAD DONATED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：間接引語中，主要動詞 stated 為過去式，且有 the previous year，表示動作發生在更早之前，應退一步使用過去完成式

SUSTAINABLE.example: Implementing sustainable practices ensures that a business can operate long-term without harming future generations.
SUSTAINABLE.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：sustainable 意為「永續的、可持續的」，符合企業長遠營運且不危害後代的主題。

WOULD NOT USE.meaning: 與現在事實相反的假設
WOULD NOT USE.example: A: 「Their public image is ruined because of the scandal.」 B: 「If they were truly ethical, they would not use such toxic materials.」
WOULD NOT USE.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：If 條件句使用過去式 (were) 表示與現在事實相反的假設，主要子句應配 would/could/might + 原形動詞。

WOULD SEVER.example: A: 「What did the board decide regarding the labor dispute?」 B: 「The chairman announced that they would sever all ties with the controversial supplier.」
WOULD SEVER.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：間接引語中，主要動詞 announced 為過去式，原本的未來式 will sever 要依時態一致性退成 would sever。

HAD EXTRACTED.meaning: 在過去某時點前已完成的事
HAD EXTRACTED.example: By the time the security breach was detected, the hackers had extracted thousands of user passwords.
HAD EXTRACTED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：By the time + 過去式，表示在過去某時點前已完成的事，搭配過去完成式

FEATURED.example: If the messaging application featured end-to-end encryption, our private conversations would be much safer.
FEATURED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：主要子句為 would be (與現在事實相反)，If 條件句需用過去簡單式 featured。

CONTAINED.example: The developer warned the users that the outdated software contained serious security vulnerabilities.
CONTAINED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：引述動詞 warned 為過去式，名詞子句中的動詞也要隨之退成過去式 contained。

CONSENT.meaning: 在了解情況下給予的同意
CONSENT.example: The service cannot share the data without consent.
CONSENT.exampleZh: 未經同意，服務提供者不能分享資料。

senses.meaning: 在了解情況下給予的同意

examples.en: The service cannot share the data without consent.
examples.zh: 未經同意，服務提供者不能分享資料。

examples.en: Consent can be withdrawn through the account settings.
examples.zh: 可以透過帳戶設定撤回同意。

HAD BYPASSED.example: A: 「Why was the central server taken offline so suddenly?」 B: 「Because the IT team found out that someone had bypassed the firewall overnight.」
HAD BYPASSED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：發現 (found out) 已經是過去式，突破防火牆發生在發現之前，必須用過去完成式

WOULD NOT HAVE LOST.example: A: 「I lost all my personal photos after the hard drive crashed.」 B: 「If you had backed up your data to the cloud, you would not have lost them.」
WOULD NOT HAVE LOST.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：條件句為 If you had backed up (與過去事實相反)，主要子句應配 would have + p.p.。

DID NOT SHARE.example: A: 「Is my personal data secure with this platform?」 B: 「The representative assured me that they did not share user information with third parties.」
DID NOT SHARE.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：assured 為過去式，依照時態一致性，名詞子句中的動作需轉換為過去式 did not share。

WOULD HAVE CORRECTED.example: If the coach had analyzed the biomechanical data carefully, he would have corrected the runner's awkward posture sooner.
WOULD HAVE CORRECTED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：If 條件句使用 had analyzed (與過去相反)，主要子句需用 would have + p.p. 表過去可能的結果

HINDERED.example: The physiotherapist explained that a persistent lack of sleep hindered the natural muscle recovery process.
HINDERED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：引述動詞 explained 為過去式，子句動詞也應退一步成為過去式 hindered。

ENDURANCE.example: Marathon runners need immense physical endurance to maintain a steady and fast pace for over two hours.
ENDURANCE.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：endurance 意為「耐力、持久力」，適合描述馬拉松跑者維持步伐所需的身體素質。

COULD RUN.example: A: 「Her sprint times are already amazing.」 B: 「If she changed her daily diet slightly, she could run even faster.」
COULD RUN.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：條件句用 changed (與現在事實相反)，主要子句配 would/could/might + 原形動詞。

HAD BECOME.meaning: 在政府認可前早已成為文化中心
HAD BECOME.example: The suburban neighborhood had become a vibrant cultural hub long before the city officially recognized it.
HAD BECOME.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：long before + 過去式 (recognized)，表示在政府認可前早已成為文化中心，使用過去完成式

PROMOTED.example: If the host country promoted more inclusive employment policies, the newcomers would feel much more welcome.
PROMOTED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：主要子句為 would feel (與現在相反的假設)，條件句需使用過去式 promoted。

PRODUCED.example: The sociologist observed that diverse communities produced more creative solutions to local administrative problems.
PRODUCED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：observed 為過去式引述動詞，子句需維持時態一致，使用過去式 produced。

ASSIMILATE.example: Language programs play a crucial role in helping children from different backgrounds assimilate into the local society.
ASSIMILATE.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：assimilate into 意指「融入、同化於」，符合幫助不同背景的孩童適應當地社會的語境。

WOULD FUND.example: A: 「What did the mayor promise the minority groups?」 B: 「He announced that the council would fund the annual multicultural festival next month.」
WOULD FUND.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：主要動詞 announced 是過去式，原本表示未來的 will fund 在間接引語中需退成 would fund。

MIGHT HAVE CAPTURED.example: If the startup had launched its mobile application in the summer, they might have captured a significantly larger user base.
MIGHT HAVE CAPTURED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：If 子句用 had launched (與過去相反)，主要子句應搭配 might have + p.p. 表過去可能的推測。

ONLY INVESTED.example: The venture capitalist stated that he only invested in early-stage companies with strong and experienced leadership teams.
ONLY INVESTED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：stated 為過去式，引述的子句動詞也必須退一步成為過去式 invested。

PROTOTYPE.example: The young software engineer built a working prototype of her device to present to potential investors at the tech conference.
PROTOTYPE.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：prototype 意為「原型」，指展示給投資人看的初期產品模型，符合新創募資情境。

HAD SPENT.example: A: 「Why did the highly anticipated tech startup fail so quickly?」 B: 「Because they had spent all their seed money before the final product was even finished.」
HAD SPENT.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：在產品完成(過去式)之前就把資金花光了，屬於過去的過去，必須用過去完成式

WOULD APPROACH.example: A: 「We simply don't have enough capital to scale our operations globally.」 B: 「If our product were more unique, angel investors would approach us immediately.」
WOULD APPROACH.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：條件句用 were 表示與現在事實相反，主要子句應使用 would + 原形動詞。

SHOULD NARROW.example: A: 「What did the marketing advisor suggest during the consultation?」 B: 「She recommended that we should narrow our target audience before spending a fortune on digital ads.」
SHOULD NARROW.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：recommended 引導的名詞子句表示建議，應使用 (should) + 原形動詞。

AGENDA.exampleZh: 我們來看看今天的議程。

EVALUATE.example: We need to evaluate the results.

PERSUADE.example: I tried to persuade her to stay.

examples.en: He finally persuaded his boss to agree.
examples.zh: 他最終說服了老闆同意。

examples.en: You cannot persuade me to buy it.
examples.zh: 你無法說服我買它。

DAILY VIRTUAL CHECK-INS.example: 【短文】Workplace Forum: Remote teams often struggle with cohesion. A team leader shared his experience, stating that his team had struggled with communication until they introduced daily virtual check-ins. Now, everyone feels much more connected. Q: What improved the team's communication?
DAILY VIRTUAL CHECK-INS.exampleZh: 【解析】團隊領袖分享經驗，提到直到他們「引進了每日虛擬報到/會議 (introduced daily virtual check-ins)」後，溝通才獲得改善，大家覺得更有連結

IMPRESSIVE.example: It was impressive to see so many people at the event.
IMPRESSIVE.exampleZh: 在活動中看到這麼多人真是令人印象深刻。

examples.en: It was impressive to see so many people at the event.
examples.zh: 在活動中看到這麼多人真是令人印象深刻。

examples.en: The presentation that she gave was truly impressive.
examples.zh: 她所做的簡報真的很令人印象深刻。

QUALIFICATION.example: Do you have any teaching qualifications?

examples.en: Do you have any teaching qualifications?
examples.zh: 你有任何教學資格嗎？

examples.en: Experience is the best qualification for this job.
examples.zh: 經驗是這份工作最好的資格條件。

PARTICIPANT.example: The participants were given a welcome gift.
PARTICIPANT.exampleZh: 參與者們收到了一份歡迎禮物。

examples.en: The participants were given a welcome gift.
examples.zh: 參與者們收到了一份歡迎禮物。

examples.en: Have all the participants arrived?
examples.zh: 所有的參與者都到了嗎？

RECOMMENDATION.example: We are writing to give a recommendation for the new software.
RECOMMENDATION.exampleZh: 我們寫信是為了給這款新軟體提供推薦。

examples.en: We are writing to give a recommendation for the new software.
examples.zh: 我們寫信是為了給這款新軟體提供推薦。

examples.en: Following his recommendation is the best way to avoid problems.
examples.zh: 聽從他的推薦是避免問題的最佳方法。

ISOLATE.example: Medical Journal: When a highly contagious disease is detected, it is vital to isolate the infected individuals from the healthy population as quickly as possible. This action prevents the medical system from becoming overwhelmed. Q: Which word best fills in the blank?
ISOLATE.exampleZh: 句意為「當發現高傳染性疾病時，盡快將受感染者與健康人群『隔離』至關重要」。

RETAIN.example: Agency Memo: As the travel industry shifts toward online booking, our agency must retain its core customer base by offering highly personalized services that websites cannot offer. Q: Which word best fills in the blank?
RETAIN.exampleZh: 句意為「隨著旅遊業轉向線上預訂，我們的機構必須透過提供網站無法提供的高度客製化服務來『保留』核心客群」。

COMMUTE.example: She commutes to the city by bus.

examples.en: She commutes to the city by bus.
examples.zh: 她搭公車通勤到市區。

examples.en: I have a long commute every morning.
examples.zh: 我每天早上有一段很長的通勤路程。

CONSENSUS.meaning: 經討論形成的大致共同意見
CONSENSUS.example: Consensus emerged after the options were compared.
CONSENSUS.exampleZh: 比較選項後形成了共識。

senses.meaning: 經討論形成的大致共同意見

examples.en: Consensus emerged after the options were compared.
examples.zh: 比較選項後形成了共識。

examples.en: Consensus does not always mean complete agreement on every detail.
examples.zh: 共識不一定代表每個細節都完全一致。

COMPREHENSIVE.example: We offer a comprehensive insurance plan.
COMPREHENSIVE.exampleZh: 我們提供全面的保險方案。

UPHELD.meaning: 本題測驗短文中的假設語氣填空
UPHELD.example: Ethics Training Guide: Maintaining a positive corporate culture requires continuous effort. If the firm upheld strict ethical guidelines consistently, it would face fewer lawsuits from disgruntled clients. Q: Which word or phrase best fills in the blank?
UPHELD.exampleZh: 本題測驗短文中的假設語氣填空。

RENTED.example: Yesterday, the man rented a large VEHICLE to move his boxes.
RENTED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：時間副詞為 Yesterday（昨天），故使用過去簡單式 (rented)。

HAD PURCHASED.example: A: "Did you manage to buy that vintage leather jacket online?" B: "No, someone else had purchased it before I even reached the checkout page."

HAD NOT DELETED.example: Wellness Blog: Taking a digital detox can reset your mental state. Looking back at her experience, Jane realized that if she had not deleted the controversial app, she would not have regained her peace of mind so quickly. Q: Which phrase best fills in the blank?
HAD NOT DELETED.exampleZh: 本題測驗與過去事實相反的假設語氣

HAD CAUSED.meaning: 或一直持續到她提及的時候
HAD CAUSED.example: A: "Why is Sarah completely offline this week?" B: "She mentioned that the flood of negative comments had caused her too much stress lately."
HAD CAUSED.exampleZh: 本題測驗間接引語時態

ITINERARY.example: Planning a detailed itinerary requires a lot of research.
ITINERARY.exampleZh: 規劃一份詳細的行程需要做很多研究。

examples.en: The itinerary which the travel agent provided looks amazing.
examples.zh: 旅行社提供的行程看起來很棒。

examples.en: We were changing the itinerary because of the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 因為大雨，我們當時正在更改行程。

PROFICIENT.example: She is proficient in three languages.

WOULD FIX.example: The software developer explained to the committee that the massive new patch would fix several critical bugs in the system.
WOULD FIX.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：主要動詞 explained 為過去式，故名詞子句中的 will fix 須配合時態退化為 would fix。

HAD TESTED.example: The principal formally announced that the school had tested a cutting-edge virtual reality program the previous semester.
HAD TESTED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：由 the previous semester 可知原本是過去式，在間接引語中退化為過去完成式

INTERNAL POLITICAL CORRUPTION.example: History Monthly: The fall of the Roman Empire remains a complex topic. While barbarian invasions are often blamed, a prominent historian noted that internal political corruption had weakened the state's foundation long before the final external attacks occurred. Q: What weakened the state according to the historian?
INTERNAL POLITICAL CORRUPTION.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：歷史學家指出，內部的政治腐敗在外部攻擊發生前就已經削弱了國家的根基。

MIGHT BE.example: The cybersecurity official urgently warned the committee that the autonomous vehicle's software might be highly vulnerable to remote hacking.
MIGHT BE.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：主要子句動詞 warned 為過去式，附屬子句的助動詞 may 須改為過去式 might。

WASTED.example: The environmental activist passionately argued that modern consumers wasted far too much food every single holiday season.
WASTED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：在間接引述過去的言論時，若不視為不變的真理，原句的現在簡單式 waste 需退化為過去式 wasted。

HAD INVESTED.example: The pharmaceutical company had invested billions in the neural implant project before they finally realized the technology was essentially flawed.

WOULD HAVE COLLAPSED.example: But for the financial support from UNESCO, the ancient city walls would have collapsed completely into ruin during the devastating earthquake last decade.

HAD GLOSSED.example: During the press conference, the CEO firmly denied that the management had glossed intentionally over the gender pay gap report earlier that year.

HEAVILY.example: Climate Report: The continuous desertification of arable land forces rural communities to flee. Without immediate agricultural interventions, the region will face a massive humanitarian crisis as millions of people become heavily dependent on international food aid. Q: Which word best fills in the blank?
HEAVILY.exampleZh: 正確答案是 C (嚴重地 / 高度地)。

HAD BEGUN.meaning: 過去時間點之前已經發生的動作
HAD BEGUN.example: A: "Was the local community consulted about the new resort construction?" B: "No, the developers had begun the land clearance before the villagers even knew about the project."

BIASES.example: Creating a truly inclusive environment requires actively dismantling the biases that often exist unconsciously in people's minds regarding gender and race.

HAD ENFORCED.example: Environmental Digest: The ice caps are melting at an unprecedented rate. A leading climatologist warned that if global leaders had enforced stricter carbon emission laws a decade ago, we would not be facing such extreme coastal erosion today. Q: Which phrase best fills in the blank?

HAD SAMPLED.example: The copyright lawyer explained to the jury that the defendant had sampled the melody from an obscure 1980s pop song without permission.

WITHDRAW.example: Ethics Journal: Using artificial intelligence to predict patient life expectancy raises serious moral questions. If an algorithm determines a patient has a low chance of survival, insurance companies might unfairly withdraw their medical coverage to save costs. Q: Which word best fills in the blank?
WITHDRAW.exampleZh: 正確答案是 A (撤回 / 取消)。

HAD RESTRICTED.meaning: 如果大國早點限制塑膠廢棄物出口
HAD RESTRICTED.example: Global Summit: The debate over ocean conservation lasted for days. A representative from the island nation stressed that if major powers had restricted their plastic waste exports earlier, marine ecosystems would not be in such a critical state today. Q: Which phrase best fills in the blank?

HAD UNDERESTIMATED.example: HR Newsletter: The shift to telecommuting has transformed our company culture. During the recent town hall meeting, the CEO admitted that she had underestimated the benefits of flexible working hours before the pandemic forced the organization to adapt. Q: Which phrase best fills in the blank?

HADNT INTERVIEWED.example: Historical Archives: Documenting oral histories is crucial for preserving local heritage. The historian mentioned that if they hadn't interviewed the elderly residents ten years ago, many fascinating stories about the town's founding would have been lost forever. Q: Which phrase best fills in the blank?

HAD IGNORED.example: Flight Compensation: Consumer rights groups are fighting for better protection against sudden flight cancellations. During the hearing, a lawyer stated that the airline had ignored the mechanical issues for weeks before the engine finally failed mid-flight. Q: Which phrase best fills in the blank?

OUTCOME.example: The outcome of the negotiation must have pleased everyone.
OUTCOME.exampleZh: 談判的結果一定讓每個人都很滿意。

ALREADY.example: I have already finished my homework.
ALREADY.exampleZh: already 放在 have 與過去分詞之間，表示「已經」。

ISSUE.example: We need to discuss this issue at the next meeting.
ISSUE.exampleZh: 我們需要在下次會議上討論這個問題。

FRAMEWORK.example: We need a clear framework for decisions.
FRAMEWORK.exampleZh: 我們需要明確的決策架構。

GLITCH.example: We experienced a minor software glitch.
GLITCH.exampleZh: 我們遇到了一個軟體小故障。

MODIFY.example: The company decided to modify their marketing campaign to target younger customers.
MODIFY.exampleZh: modify 是「修改、調整」，為了吸引年輕顧客而調整行銷活動。

RELUCTANT.meaning: 因不願意而有所猶豫的
RELUCTANT.example: She was reluctant to open the letter.

MODIFIED.exampleZh: 此例句展示了「已經被修改」。

PLAN.example: Do you have any plans for the weekend?

MALFUNCTION.example: The system suffered a major malfunction yesterday.
MALFUNCTION.exampleZh: 系統昨天發生了重大故障。

ANNOUNCE.exampleZh: 他們宣布了一項新產品。

RESOLVE.example: We must resolve this issue quickly.
RESOLVE.exampleZh: 我們必須盡快解決這個問題。

INFORM.example: We have already informed the client about the delay.
INFORM.exampleZh: 我們已經通知客戶關於延遲的事。

COGNITIVE.meaning: 與思考理解等認知活動相關的
COGNITIVE.example: The two tasks impose different cognitive demands.
COGNITIVE.exampleZh: 兩個任務有不同的認知要求。

TEST.example: We have an English test today.

BETTER.example: After taking the pills and getting some sleep, she feels much better today.
BETTER.exampleZh: much 用來修飾比較級，good 的比較級是不規則變化 better。

SCENERY.example: We enjoyed the breathtaking mountain scenery during our trip to Taroko last year.
SCENERY.exampleZh: 我們去年去太魯閣旅行時欣賞了令人屏息的山景風光。

ADMIT.example: He admitted making a mistake on the report.
ADMIT.exampleZh: 他承認在報告上犯了錯。

SAFETY.example: For safety reasons, please wear your helmet.
SAFETY.exampleZh: 為了安全起見，請戴上你的安全帽。

TOURIST.example: The museum is full of tourists.

COME.example: Please come in and sit down.

MENTION.example: The budget issue was mentioned in the morning meeting.
MENTION.exampleZh: 預算問題在早會中被提及了。

MADE.example: It is high time we made a decision.
MADE.exampleZh: It is (high) time + 主詞 + 過去式，表示「早該做某事了」。

MISTAKE.example: I promise I will not make the same mistake again.
MISTAKE.exampleZh: 我保證我不會再犯同樣的錯誤。

CLIENT.example: We have a meeting with a new client.

ACCEPT.example: I will accept the job offer tomorrow.
ACCEPT.exampleZh: 我明天將會接受這份工作邀約。

COMPROMISE.example: We need to reach a compromise.

HAPPEN.exampleZh: 昨天發生了一場意料之外的延誤。

CONTRACT.example: Both parties agreed to sign the contract.

REVIEW.example: The document has been reviewed by the manager.
REVIEW.exampleZh: 這份文件已經由經理審查過了。

TERMS.meaning: 正視、妥協並逐漸接受痛苦現實
TERMS.example: After decades of historical denial, the nation is finally coming to terms with its colonial transgressions.
TERMS.exampleZh: come to terms with 表示「正視、妥協並逐漸接受痛苦現實」。

SUGGESTION.example: Do you have any suggestions for improving the design?
SUGGESTION.exampleZh: 你有什麼改進設計的建議嗎？

DELAYED.exampleZh: 此例句展示了「延遲；延誤」。

FRIDAY.exampleZh: 此例句展示了「Friday 星期五」。

SYSTEM.example: The new computer system is fast.

TALK.example: I need to talk to you.

WORKING.example: We look forward to working with you.
WORKING.exampleZh: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後接 V-ing。

PRODUCT.exampleZh: 我們的新產品賣得很好。

TELL.example: Can you tell me the way to the station?
TELL.exampleZh: 你可以告訴我去車站的路嗎？

GOING.example: 「I am going to travel to Paris.」請選出正確符合未來式 going to 的選項：
GOING.exampleZh: be going to 表示未來的計畫。

BUY.example: I bought two tickets for the morning flight.
BUY.exampleZh: 我買了兩張早班機的機票。

WEEK.example: I work five days a week.

FAMOUS.example: This bakery became famous after winning an international competition in 2022.
FAMOUS.exampleZh: 這家烘焙坊在 2022 年贏得國際大賽後一舉成名。

SAY.example: Suffice it to say that diplomatic ambiguity often serves to avert immediate military escalation.
SAY.exampleZh: Suffice it to say 為原形虛擬式成語，意為「只需說…就夠了。

LIKE.meaning: 點餐最常用的禮貌說法
LIKE.example: I'd like a cup of coffee, please.
LIKE.exampleZh: I'd like + 名詞，是點餐最常用的禮貌說法。

SHOW.example: The report shows a steady growth in sales.
SHOW.exampleZh: 報告顯示銷售持續成長。

KNOW.example: Do you know the answer to this question?

COMPANY.example: She works for a big company.

OFFER.example: They offered him a managerial position.
OFFER.exampleZh: 他們向他提供了一個管理職位。

CONDITION.example: The device is in perfect condition.

STAFF.example: We have the best staff in the city.
STAFF.exampleZh: 我們有全城市最優秀的員工。

TRAVEL.example: I love to travel by train.

CHANGE.example: We must change our strategy to stay competitive.
CHANGE.exampleZh: 我們必須改變策略以保持競爭力。

CHECKING.example: Please keep checking the online tracking number until the package safely arrives at your door.
CHECKING.exampleZh: 動詞 keep 表示「持續做某事」時，後面必須接動名詞 (V-ing)，因此選 B. checking。

REPORT.example: Please submit your quarterly report by Friday.
REPORT.exampleZh: 請於週五前提交您的季度報告。

THERE.example: there are two birds in the park.
THERE.exampleZh: There are 表示「有」，後面接複數名詞 two birds，所以選 There。

SOLVE.example: The problem has already been solved.
SOLVE.exampleZh: 這個問題已經被解決了。

WORSE.example: The hurricane in the south was much worse than the news predicted.
WORSE.exampleZh: than 提示需要比較級，bad 的比較級為不規則變化 worse。

TAKE.example: It takes twenty minutes to walk there.
TAKE.exampleZh: 走路到那裡需要二十分鐘。

REGULATION.example: New regulations take effect in May.

READ.example: Read the contract carefully before signing.
READ.exampleZh: 簽約前請仔細閱讀合約。

CHARGE.example: How much will you charge for this service?
CHARGE.exampleZh: 這項服務你們將收費多少？

HANDLE.example: She knows how to handle difficult customers.
HANDLE.exampleZh: 她知道如何處理難纏的顧客。

WRITE.example: She wrote a detailed summary of the event.
WRITE.exampleZh: 她寫了一份詳盡的活動摘要。

STORE.example: I go to the store to buy milk.

ARRIVE.example: We arrived at the hotel at noon.

SUSTAINABILITY.meaning: 不耗盡後代資源之永續發展
SUSTAINABILITY.example: The university launched an interdisciplinary institute dedicated to real world systemic sustainability.
SUSTAINABILITY.exampleZh: 這所頂尖學府斥巨資成立了跨學科前沿研究所，專注於攻克人類文明在真實世界中面臨的系統性永續性重大難題。

ATTRACT.example: The new route has attracted many tourists.
ATTRACT.exampleZh: 這條新路線已經吸引了許多遊客。

ASK.example: A: Do you know the answer to Question 5? B: No, I don't. Let's ask the teacher for help.
ASK.exampleZh: 祈使句提議句型「Let's」後面必須接動詞原形，故選 ask。

SOFTWARE.example: We need to update the software.

RESULT.example: If you practice every day, you will see good results.
RESULT.exampleZh: 如果你每天練習，你將會看到好結果。

IMPLEMENT.example: We will implement the plan in June.
IMPLEMENT.exampleZh: 我們將在六月實施計畫。

PREVIOUS.example: Do you have any previous experience in sales?
PREVIOUS.exampleZh: 你有任何先前的銷售經驗嗎？

COMPLETE.example: You have to complete this task by Friday.
COMPLETE.exampleZh: 你必須在星期五前完成這項任務。

REALIZE.example: I have just realized my mistake in the email.
REALIZE.exampleZh: 我才剛意識到我在電子郵件裡的錯誤。

LAPTOP.example: I brought my laptop to the meeting.

CHARGER.example: I need to charge my phone, but I forgot to bring the charger.
CHARGER.exampleZh: charger 是「充電器」，用來給手機充電 (charge my phone)。

LEAVE.example: The train leaves at ten sharp.

SUCCESSFUL.example: The event was successfully organized by the team.
SUCCESSFUL.exampleZh: 這次活動已由團隊成功舉辦。

DELAY.example: The heavy rain delayed our trip.
DELAY.exampleZh: 大雨延誤了我們的行程。

DELETE.example: I will delete the old files from my computer.
DELETE.exampleZh: 我將會從我的電腦刪除舊檔案。

INSTRUCTION.example: The instructions were written in English.
INSTRUCTION.exampleZh: 這些說明是以英文撰寫的。

SUPERVISOR.example: The supervisor who trained me expects everyone to work efficiently.
SUPERVISOR.exampleZh: 培訓我的主管期望每個人都能有效率地工作。

EXPLAIN.example: The trainer explained the workplace safety rules clearly yesterday.
EXPLAIN.exampleZh: 培訓講師昨天清楚地解釋了職場安全守則。

FUNCTION.example: The main function of this tool has been updated.
FUNCTION.exampleZh: 這個工具的主要功能已經更新了。

NEED.example: I need a pen to write.

DECIDE.example: We decided to launch the product in autumn.
DECIDE.exampleZh: 我們決定在秋季推出這項產品。

PROMOTE.exampleZh: 此例句展示了「晉升；提拔」。

BIODIVERSITY.meaning: 生物種類與生態差異的多樣性
BIODIVERSITY.example: The project aims to protect biodiversity along the river.
BIODIVERSITY.exampleZh: 計畫旨在保護河岸生物多樣性。

INITIATE.example: They must have initiated the new protocol without informing us.
INITIATE.exampleZh: 他們一定是在沒有通知我們的情況下啟動了新協定。

SUDDENLY.example: We were walking when it suddenly rained.
SUDDENLY.exampleZh: 我們散步時突然下雨了。

GO.example: They go to work by bus.

IMPORTANT.example: Water is important for our health.
IMPORTANT.exampleZh: 水對我們的健康很重要。

PROMISE.example: She promised to help me with the homework.

SUBMITTED.example: The report must be submitted to the manager by Friday.
SUBMITTED.exampleZh: must be + p.p. 被動語態：報告「被」提交。

GOAL.exampleZh: 此例句展示了「設定新目標」。

IMPROVE.example: Customer service has been improved recently.
IMPROVE.exampleZh: 客戶服務最近已經得到改善。

OVERALL.example: The overall experience that we had at the resort was wonderful.
OVERALL.exampleZh: 我們在度假村擁有的整體體驗非常棒。

SEPARATE.example: The two groups have been separated.

EXHAUSTED.example: I was completely exhausted after the long flight from London.
EXHAUSTED.exampleZh: 在從倫敦長途飛行之後，我已經完全精疲力竭了。

STOP.example: The bus will stop right outside the museum.
STOP.exampleZh: 公車會正好停在博物館外。

MANUAL.example: Reading the manual is necessary before using the machine.
MANUAL.exampleZh: 在使用機器之前閱讀手冊是必要的。

COMMUNITY.example: He has lived in this community for ten years.
COMMUNITY.exampleZh: 他已經在這個社區住了十年了。

MARY.meaning: 瑪麗今天將代替他主持
MARY.example:
【短文理解】[Business Email] Dear Team, John is sick today and cannot lead the marketing meeting at 3 p.m. Mary will take his place today. Please send your weekly reports to Mary before 2 p.m.
Q: Who will lead the marketing meeting today?
MARY.exampleZh: 文中明確提到「Mary will take his place today」（瑪麗今天將代替他主持），因此今天由 Mary 主持會議

SENT.meaning: 描述已發生的錯誤動作
SENT.example: She sent the email to the wrong person by mistake.
SENT.exampleZh: 描述已發生的錯誤動作，用過去式 sent。

REMINDER.example: I am sending this email to serve as a gentle reminder.
REMINDER.exampleZh: 我寄這封電子郵件是作為一個善意的提醒。

ASSISTANT.example: My assistant will call you back.

PROPOSAL.exampleZh: 董事會接受了我們的提案。

HIRE.example: The company plans to hire ten people.

ENGINEER.example: The software engineer solved the critical database issue yesterday.
ENGINEER.exampleZh: 那位軟體工程師昨天解決了嚴重的資料庫問題。

QUARTER.example: The appointment is at a quarter past two.
